title: The Diagnostic Features of Peripheral Blood Biomarkers in Identifying Osteoarthritis Individuals: Machine Learning Strategies and Clinical Evidence.
authors: Zhou, Qiao; Liu, Jian; Xin, Ling; Hu, Yuedi; Qi, Yajun
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习筛选骨关节炎外周血诊断生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子基因但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模，属纯表达与临床诊断分析，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: People with osteoarthritis place a huge burden on society. Early diagnosis is essential to prevent disease progression and to select the best treatment strategy more effectively. In this study, the aim was to examine the diagnostic features and clinical value of peripheral blood biomarkers for osteoarthritis. OBJECTIVE: The goal of this project was to investigate the diagnostic features of peripheral blood and immune cell infiltration in osteoarthritis (OA). METHODS: Two eligible datasets (GSE63359 and GSE48556) were obtained from the GEO database to discern differentially expressed genes (DEGs). The machine learning strategy was employed to filtrate diagnostic biomarkers for OA. Additional verification was implemented by collecting clinical samples of OA. The CIBERSORT website estimated relative subsets of RNA transcripts to evaluate the immune-inflammatory states of OA. The link between specific DEGs and clinical immune-inflammatory markers was found by correlation analysis. RESULTS: Overall, 67 robust DEGs were identified. The nuclear receptor subfamily 2 group C member 2 (NR2C2), transcription factor 4 (TCF4), stromal antigen 1 (STAG1), and interleukin 18 receptor accessory protein (IL18RAP) were identified as effective diagnostic markers of OA in peripheral blood. All four diagnostic markers showed significant increases in expression in OA. Analysis of immune cell infiltration revealed that macrophages are involved in the occurrence of OA. Candidate diagnostic markers were correlated with clinical immune-inflammatory indicators of OA patients. CONCLUSION: We highlight that DEGs associated with immune inflammation (NR2C2, TCF4, STAG1, and IL18RAP) may be potential biomarkers for peripheral blood in OA, which are also associated with clinical immune-inflammatory indicators.
abstract_zh: 背景：骨关节炎患者给社会带来了巨大负担。早期诊断对于预防疾病进展和更有效地选择最佳治疗策略至关重要。本研究旨在探讨骨关节炎外周血生物标志物的诊断特征及临床价值。目的：本项目旨在研究骨关节炎（OA）外周血及免疫细胞浸润的诊断特征。方法：从GEO数据库获取两个符合条件的数据集（GSE63359和GSE48556），以识别差异表达基因（DEGs）。采用机器学习策略筛选OA的诊断生物标志物。通过收集OA临床样本进行额外验证。利用CIBERSORT网站估计相对RNA转录本子集，以评估OA的免疫炎症状态。通过相关性分析发现特定DEGs与临床免疫炎症标志物之间的联系。结果：总体共识别出67个稳健的DEGs。核受体亚家族2组C成员2（NR2C2）、转录因子4（TCF4）、基质抗原1（STAG1）和白细胞介素18受体辅助蛋白（IL18RAP）被确定为OA外周血的有效诊断标志物。所有四种诊断标志物在OA中均表现出显著表达增加。免疫细胞浸润分析显示，巨噬细胞参与OA的发生。候选诊断标志物与OA患者的临床免疫炎症指标相关。结论：我们强调与免疫炎症相关的DEGs（NR2C2、TCF4、STAG1和IL18RAP）可能是OA外周血的潜在生物标志物，这些标志物也与临床免疫炎症指标相关。
